data/countries-co2.json.source: Global Carbon Project (GCB) and others, compiled by Our World in Data co2-data
data/countries-co2.json.note: Territorial fossil CO2 in MtCO2 (co2). Each 'latest' value is [value, year]. Latest year may be a preliminary GCB estimate.

data/countries.geojson.note: Boundaries are generalised; shown for orientation, not as legal boundaries.

data/power-plants.json.source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0
data/power-plants.json.note: Plant locations, capacity and generation are WRI data (last updated 2021). co2_mt_est is a Climactix estimate = generation × fuel emission factor; unit efficiency, co-firing and CCS are not modelled.

data/airports.json.note: Large airports only. Aviation emissions are not attributed per airport.

data/ports.json.note: Port locations only; no throughput or emissions.

data/gistemp-global.json.source: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4)
data/gistemp-global.json.note: Annual (Jan–Dec) global mean land-ocean temperature anomaly relative to 1951–1980. Not the same baseline as IPCC warming levels (1850–1900).

mumbai/tileset.json.source: Overture Maps Foundation buildings (2026-11-18.0); heights from OpenStreetMap tags where present, otherwise JRC GHSL GHS-BUILT-H R2023A (2018 epoch, ~90 m average net building height)
mumbai/tileset.json.note: Height basis per building (COLOR_0.b × 255 / 60): 0 = OSM height tag, 1 = OSM floor count × 3.1 m + 1 m, 2 = GHSL cell mean height (buildings in the same ~90 m cell share one value), 3 = 4 m minimum. Counts: {'osm_height': 108, 'floors': 3360, 'ghsl': 198662, 'minimum': 465, 'skipped_small': 32913}

mumbai/transport.json.note: Road classes motorway–secondary and rail segments.

mumbai/facilities.geojson.source: Overture Maps Foundation base land use / infrastructure (2026-11-18.0)
mumbai/facilities.geojson.note: Footprints only. Operational and emissions attributes are curated separately and labelled by provenance in the UI.

data/sector-inventory.json.source: Climate Watch Historical GHG Emissions (CAIT), World Resources Institute
data/sector-inventory.json.note: National inventory estimates by IPCC sector, all greenhouse gases in MtCO2e. Last 10 reported years per sector. Electricity/Heat, Transportation, Manufacturing and Buildings are energy sub-sectors; LUCF can be negative (net removals).

mumbai/water.geojson.source: Overture Maps Foundation base theme — water (2026-11-18.0)
mumbai/water.geojson.note: Inland water polygons > 0.4 ha (rivers, creeks, lakes, reservoirs). Open sea is not included.
